# CGB Industries

> Owner-operated pressure washing and concrete sealing business on the
> Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia, for residential and commercial
> properties.

CGB Industries is a service-area business covering Buderim, Forest Glen,
Maroochydore, Mooloolaba, Caloundra, Nambour, Sippy Downs, Mountain Creek,
Mons and the wider Sunshine Coast. The owner quotes and performs every job
— no subcontractors. Quotes are free and usually returned within 48 hours.

Contact: 0414 438 169 | cgbindustries@outlook.com.au
ABN 12 508 435 400

## Services

- [Pressure Washing](https://cgbindustries.com.au/pressure-washing): Rotary
  surface cleaning for driveways, carparks, paths, pool surrounds, alfresco
  and patio areas, fencing, retaining walls and body corporate common areas.
  Rotary surface cleaners are used rather than hand-held wands, giving an
  even finish without striping or etching. Covers pricing factors,
  recommended cleaning frequency, the four-step process and FAQs.
- [Concrete Sealing](https://cgbindustries.com.au/concrete-sealing): Clear
  sealing, colour enhancement for exposed aggregate and coloured concrete,
  and anti-slip coatings — all rated for UV and salt exposure. Covers what
  sealing protects against in a coastal Queensland climate, sealer cure
  times and FAQs.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cgbindustries.com.au/): Overview of both services, before and

## Facts

- Business type: service-area business, no public shopfront
- Location: Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia
- Owner trade experience: 20+ years in concreting
- Quote turnaround: usually within 48 hours
- Quote cost: free, no obligation
- Surfaces worked on: concrete, exposed aggregate, coloured concrete
